newsitem.title: FINLAND: TELIA BUYS MAJORITY IN VIESTI-TUOTE GROUP.
newsitem.headline: TELIA BUYS MAJORITY IN VIESTI-TUOTE GROUP.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Telia AB said in a statement on Monday it had acquired 80 percent of Finnish GSM-Viestimet Oy, the parent company of telecoms equipment chain Viesti-Tuote, for an undisclosed sum.
"The aim is to make Viesti-Tuote group an even stronger services chain, which will operate in all the most important economic areas on a franchising basis," Telia said.
Viesti-Tuote had a 141 million markka net sales in 1995 and it has 83 employees.
After the acquisition, Telia has more than 300 employees in Finland and its combined Finnish net sales are more than 400 million markka, Telia said.
